title: Stafford’s Conjecture 3.8: paper and Lean proof comparison
description:
Open the paper and Lean proof comparison.

All 69 passages of the manuscript, each beside the Lean declaration of its statement and the steps of its Lean proof, with direct links to the exact sources. Also a page that sets out, for every definition of the paper, the form the Lean proofs work with and the theorems connecting the two; proof dependency graphs of the paper and of the Lean proof; and the manuscript PDF. Download the ZIP, unzip it, and open index.html in a browser.

Uses formal proof v1.4.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24140371) and the November 11, 2026 manuscript.
